gemma4.summary: AtlasGraphCanvas.svelte renders the Atlas knowledge-graph visualization surface, wiring node/edge rendering to the underlying graph data model and interaction handlers.
gemma4.risk: Patching risks breaking live graph rendering, node/edge layout, and any in-flight graphify:daily refresh or Karpathy-score display that depends on this component.
gemma4.rationale: This file is the right target because it is the user-facing graph canvas that consumes the hyperedge corpus and ontology-linked tuples, so it is where the binary-only corpus, empty ontology_linked_tuples, and stale Karpathy scores would surface as visible rendering gaps.
